descriptor: WCAG colour contrast checker for designers

voice.summary: Hueproof reads like a calm accessibility colleague who shows the ratio first and the opinion second. It is precise with numbers, kind about failures, and always follows a fail with a way to fix it.
dos: Lead with the ratio, then the verdict
Name the WCAG level and text size explicitly
Offer a concrete fix after every failure
donts: Do not scold designers for failing
Never present AA and AAA as interchangeable

taglines: Check the pair. Fix the pair
boilerplate: Hueproof is a free colour contrast checker that tests any text and background pair against WCAG AA and AAA, shows a live preview and suggests the nearest passing colour.

microcopy.error: That is not a valid hex colour. Try six characters, like 1d4f91.
microcopy.empty: Pick two colours to see the ratio.

logo.note: An aperture reflects light let in and seen clearly, a nod to testing how colours are actually perceived.
